sections.content: Accessible HTML means everyone can use your page: semantic landmarks, alt text, sufficient contrast, keyboard navigation, and ARIA only when HTML falls short.
Test by unplugging your mouse — can you reach everything? Screen readers announce landmarks, headings, and form labels; get those right first.
Key points: lang attribute on <html>, skip-to-content links, visible focus styles, and never convey meaning by color alone.
